definition: Pressure, failure and anxiety directly tied to exams, marks and studying.
Uncertainty and stress about placements, jobs, salary and future pathways.
Guidance, decisions and resource-sharing with limited affective distress.
In-group memes, humour and venting used to process distress collectively.
Explicit mental-health signals: depression, suicidal ideation, burnout, loneliness.
Frustration with coaching institutes, exam administration and logistics.
